question: Lui Ngai Ni is a festival that is associated with which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lui Ngai Ni is a festival that is celebrated in the state of Manipur.**
 
• **Lui Ngai Ni** is a seed-sowing festival celebrated by the** Naga tribes of Manipur.**
 
• It marks the** beginning **of the new **agricultural season** and is usually observed in February.
 
• The festival is characterized by** traditional songs, dances, and rituals performed by the Naga communities.** It is a time for rejoicing and thanking the gods for a bountiful harvest.
 
• The festival is also an occasion for the Naga tribes to showcase their rich cultural heritage and traditional attire.
 
• Tourists from all over the world visit Manipur during this time to witness the celebrations.
 
• Manipur is a state located in Northeast India, bordering Nagaland, Mizoram, and Assam. It is known for its scenic beauty, rich history, and diverse culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh: **Uttar Pradesh is a state in North India known for its rich cultural heritage and historical monuments. Some of the popular festivals celebrated in the state include Diwali, Holi, Eid, and Dussehra. However, Lui Ngai Ni is not celebrated in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Uttarakhand:** Uttarakhand is a state located in North India known for its scenic beauty and pilgrimage sites. Some of the popular festivals celebrated in the state include Kumbh Mela, Ganga Dussehra, and Bikhauti Mela. However, Lui Ngai Ni is not celebrated in Uttarakhand.
 
• **Himachal Pradesh:** Himachal Pradesh is a state located in North India known for its scenic beauty and adventure tourism. Some of the popular festivals celebrated in the state include Diwali, Holi, and Baisakhi. However, Lui Ngai Ni is not celebrated in Himachal Pradesh.
